data.reasoning: The commercial bank already scores 82.6, above its 75 threshold. The only thing blocking approval is the active default, which is a hard reason. Settling it takes about 1 month and is the only step the owner has to do. The overdue receivables are a soft reason and the score doesn't need them fixed, so I left them out. This is faster than the digital lender, which would need the overdue receivables cleared first (3 months).
